picks.title: Dreamtonics Completes Its Trilogy With Instrument X
picks.headline: Dreamtonics Completes Its Trilogy With Instrument X
picks.excerpt: Dreamtonics completes its trilogy with Instrument X, a neural acoustic modelling platform for orchestral instruments that swaps multi-gigabyte sample libraries for a trained model. It joins Synthesizer V and Vocoflex as the Tokyo company's third neural instrument.
picks.rationale: A trained neural model replacing multi-gigabyte orchestral sample libraries changes what a composer installs and how a session loads — the most concretely actionable release in the pool.

picks.title: The sonible smart:chain Plugin is an Intelligent Mixing Ecosystem
picks.headline: The sonible smart:chain Plugin is an Intelligent Mixing Ecosystem
picks.excerpt: With sonible smart:chain, the processing chain draws analysis from multiple instances across your DAW so each channel is shaped in the context of the whole mix. Seven processors share one AI analysis rather than each guessing in isolation.
picks.rationale: Cross-instance analysis means AI mixing tools finally hear the whole session instead of one channel — a direct change to how a mix gets built tomorrow.

picks.title: Accentize Chameleon wins Emmy Award
picks.headline: Accentize Chameleon wins Emmy Award
picks.excerpt: Accentize has received an Engineering, Science & Technology Emmy Award for Chameleon, a plug-in that uses machine learning to automatically match the reverb characteristics of one recording to another. The tool has become a staple of dialogue post-production for film and TV.
picks.rationale: An ML reverb-matching plug-in taking a technical Emmy is the clearest signal yet that AI audio repair has become standard post-production infrastructure, not an experiment.

picks.title: Songscription talks AI and music publishing: 'We need to work alongside the industry'
picks.headline: Songscription talks AI and music publishing: 'We need to work alongside the industry'
picks.excerpt: Startup Songscription turns recordings into playable sheet music with automatic music transcription, and is now pitching that engine to publishers rather than around them. Its founders argue transcription AI is the cooperative end of the music-AI spectrum.
picks.rationale: Automatic transcription is the rare music-AI product that publishers can license instead of sue, and it hands players usable notation from any recording.

picks.title: SOCAN Sues Suno Over Alleged Copyright Infringement
picks.headline: SOCAN Sues Suno Over Alleged Copyright Infringement
picks.excerpt: Canadian rights organisation SOCAN has filed a copyright infringement suit against Suno in the Federal Court of Canada, identifying 150 Suno-generated tracks it says reproduce works in its repertoire. It is the first Canadian collecting-society action against a generative music platform.
picks.rationale: The first collecting society outside the US to take Suno to court, with 150 named tracks as evidence — it moves the licensing fight from label lawsuits to performing-rights repertoire.
